end.summary:
Identified standing, sleeping, and slanting straight lines in practice and examples.
Recognised that straight lines do not bend and distinguished them from a curved, round line.
Explained that V has two slanting straight lines meeting at a corner, not curved lines.
Applied line-position labels to H, T, and A; a new-situation explanation remains to be checked.
end.parentNote: Om practised standing, sleeping, and slanting lines, and telling straight lines from curved lines. They used the method of looking at direction and whether a line bends, including in V, H, T, and A. The practice examples were answered correctly; the straight-versus-curved idea still needs a why or new-example check next time. At home, ask Om to find one standing, one sleeping, one slanting, and one curved line in everyday objects and say how they know.
